messages:
Maya: Heads-up — thinking we should tweak the weekly triage to handle both quick hotfixes and deeper backlog work without going over time.
Ravi: +1 interested. what's the concrete change you have in mind?
Maya: Proposal: split the 45m slot into 15m 'hotfix lane' (fast unblock, owner handoff) + 30m 'backlog & deep triage' (owners present). Keeps quick stuff from derailing the deep discussion.
Sam: That sounds reasonable. timezone note: our APAC folks leave earlier, so rotating the owners matters.
Ava: Can we try a cadence where owners rotate weekly but the hotfix lane owner stays for 2 weeks? reduces churn for the fast lane.
Maya: Yup — suggested rotation: hotfix-owner rotates every 2 weeks, backlog-owner rotates weekly. Also require async pre-read for backlog items (PRs + 2 bullet context).
Dmitri: Love the async pre-read. Can we add a short 'action check' at the end — 3 bullets: who owns, ETA, follow-up channel? keeps things actionable.
Maya: Agreed. Draft agenda below:

```
15m Hotfix lane (owner on-call): quick triage, assign, unblock
30m Backlog deep triage: pre-reads reviewed, decisions, follow-ups
3m Action check: assign owners + ETAs
Async: add items to #eng-triage-prs with pre-read 24h before
```

Ravi: Looks good. Two quick Qs: 1) Should we keep current calendar time? 2) Who will update invites and add rotating owners?
Maya: Keep current time for now to avoid churn. I'll update invites if we have a list of volunteers. @Ava @Dmitri you okay to start as the next two hotfix owners?
Ava: I can take the next two weeks. :thumbsup:
Dmitri: I can take the following two-week slot. :+1:
Sam: I'll help with the calendar rotation script if you want — can automate owner swaps and post a reminder 2h before.
Maya: That would be awesome, Sam. If doable, add a line in the invite description with the current owners + link to rotation doc.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite updated by Sam. Owners field: Hotfix owner = Ava (2w), Backlog owner = Maya (this week). Invite description: "Please add pre-read links 24h before or add to #eng-triage-prs".
Ravi: Can we run this split for two sprints as an experiment and then decide?
Maya: Yes — two-sprint trial. I'll post an async pulse at the end of each sprint with metrics (avg meeting time, #hotfixes handled, number of backlog decisions) and a quick survey.
Ava: one small nit — for hotfix lane, allow a single follow-up slot for infra emergencies; otherwise we keep it short.
Maya: Noted. I'll add that to the invite description.
Sam: I'll drop a tiny script in the repo to rotate owners and post the weekly owner message in #eng. Ping me if you want the repo link now.
Dmitri: Sounds great. thanks everyone.
Maya: Thanks — will update invites and post the trial plan in #eng and #eng-triage-prs. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll flip the invites.
Ravi: :thumbsup:
Ava: :+1:
